commands.frames2video:
Usage:
  dreamina frames2video [flags]

Upload two local images as first and last frames, then submit a Dreamina video generation task. The task is asynchronous, but --poll can wait briefly before falling back to query_result.

Supported combinations:
- model_version: seedance1.5pro, seedance2.0, seedance2.0fast, seedance2.0_vip, seedance2.0fast_vip, seedance2.0mini, seedance2.5
- ratio: 1:1, 3:4, 16:9, 4:3, 9:16, 21:9
- seedance2.5 -> video_resolution 480p, 720p, or 1080p; duration 4-30s; VIP-only
- seedance2.0_vip -> video_resolution 720p, 1080p, or 4k; duration 4-15s
- seedance1.5pro -> video_resolution 720p; duration 5-12s
- all other seedance2.0 models -> video_resolution 720p; duration 4-15s

Notes:
- --video_resolution is required
- omit --ratio to infer it from the first-frame image; Seedance 2.0 models can set it independently; seedance2.5 reference-frame generation follows the first frame and rejects --ratio; legacy models require it to match the first frame
- default model_version: seedance2.0_vip
- default duration: 5s
- listed model values are the CLI's public support set; runtime availability is determined by backend configuration
- duration, video_resolution, and any explicitly supplied ratio are strictly validated; unsupported or legacy values are rejected instead of silently adjusted
- 部分模型首次使用时，需要先在即梦 Web 端使用该模型完成首次生成。若提交生成任务后返回 AigcComplianceConfirmationRequired提示，则属于该情况。 For some models, first-time use requires completing an initial generation with the model on Dreamina Web. If the AigcComplianceConfirmationRequired message is returned after submitting a generation task, this requirement applies.


Flags:
      --first string              local first-frame image path
      --last string               local last-frame image path
      --prompt string             generation prompt
      --session int               session id (default 0 "默认对话") 
      --duration int              video duration in seconds; supported ranges: seedance1.5pro -> 5-12, seedance2.0 family/seedance2.0mini -> 4-15, seedance2.5 -> 4-30 (default 5)
      --ratio string              supported values: 1:1, 3:4, 16:9, 4:3, 9:16, 21:9; omit to infer from the first-frame image; not accepted with model_version seedance2.5
      --video_resolution string   required; supported values by model: seedance2.5 -> 480p, 720p, or 1080p; seedance2.0_vip -> 720p, 1080p, or 4k; all other models -> 720p
      --model_version string      supported values: seedance1.5pro, seedance2.0, seedance2.0fast, seedance2.0_vip, seedance2.0fast_vip, seedance2.0mini, seedance2.5; default: seedance2.0_vip
      --poll int                  submit then poll query_result for up to N seconds at 1s intervals (0 disables polling)
  -h, --help                      help for frames2video

Global Flags:
      --version   print build version information

Examples:
  dreamina frames2video --first=./start.png --last=./end.png --prompt="season changes" --ratio=16:9 --video_resolution=720p
commands.image2image:
Usage:
  dreamina image2image [flags]

Upload 1 to 10 local images, then submit a Dreamina image-to-image task. The task is asynchronous, but --poll can wait briefly before falling back to query_result.

Supported combinations:
- model_version: 4.0, 4.1, 4.5, 4.6, 4.7, 5.0, 5.0Pro
- ratio: 21:9, 16:9, 3:2, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16
- generate_num: 1-10
- 4.0/4.1/4.5/4.6/4.7/5.0 -> resolution_type 2k or 4k
- 5.0Pro -> resolution_type 1.5k, 2k, or 4k

Custom width/height:
- --width and --height must be provided together as positive integers and are mutually exclusive with --ratio
- --resolution_type is required; limits are checked against the selected resolution
- 1k: each side 512-2016; total pixels <= 1763584
- 1.5k: each side 972-2268; total pixels <= 2359296
- 2k: each side 768-3072; total pixels <= 4194304
- 4k: each side 1536-6240; total pixels <= 16777216
- each-side and total-pixel limits must both be satisfied; backend configuration is the final authority
- width/height are target dimensions; the backend/model may align final output dimensions, so query_result is authoritative

Notes:
- --resolution_type is required
- default model_version: 5.0
- omit --ratio to use 16:9 unless custom width/height is provided
- omit --generate_num to generate 1 image
- resolution_type and any explicitly supplied ratio are strictly validated; unsupported or legacy values are rejected instead of silently adjusted
- 一次最多上传十张图片，否则可能导致生图失败


Flags:
      --images strings           local input image paths
      --prompt string            edit prompt
      --session int              session id (default 0 "默认对话") 
      --ratio string             supported values: 21:9, 16:9, 3:2, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16; default: 16:9
      --resolution_type string   required; supported values by model: 4.0/4.1/4.5/4.6/4.7/5.0 -> 2k or 4k; 5.0Pro -> 1.5k, 2k, or 4k
      --width int                custom output width in pixels; requires --height; mutually exclusive with --ratio
      --height int               custom output height in pixels; requires --width; mutually exclusive with --ratio
      --model_version string     supported values: 4.0, 4.1, 4.5, 4.6, 4.7, 5.0, 5.0Pro; default: 5.0
      --generate_num int         number of images to generate; supported range: 1-10 (default 1)
      --poll int                 submit then poll query_result for up to N seconds at 1s intervals (0 disables polling)
  -h, --help                     help for image2image

Global Flags:
      --version   print build version information

Examples:
  dreamina image2image --images ./input.png --prompt="turn into watercolor" --resolution_type=2k

commands.multimodal2video:
Usage:
  dreamina multimodal2video [flags]

Upload local images, videos, and audio, then submit Dreamina's flagship multimodal video generation mode. This corresponds to the "全能参考" (All-around reference) feature on the web interface (formerly known as ref2video). It supports Seedance video models (flag values: seedance2.0, seedance2.0fast, seedance2.0_vip, seedance2.0fast_vip, seedance2.0mini, seedance2.5). The task is asynchronous, but --poll can wait briefly before falling back to query_result.

Supported combinations:
- inputs: any mix of --image, --video, --audio
- seedance2.5 -> audio-only is allowed; image<=30, video<=10, audio<=10, total inputs<=50; each and total video/audio duration 2-30s; video_resolution 480p, 720p, or 1080p; output duration 4-30s; VIP-only
- seedance2.0 family/seedance2.0mini -> at least one --image or --video is required; image<=9, video<=3, audio<=3, total inputs<=12; each and total video/audio duration 2-15s
- seedance2.0_vip -> video_resolution 720p, 1080p, or 4k
- all other seedance2.0 models -> video_resolution 720p
- ratio: 1:1, 3:4, 16:9, 4:3, 9:16, 21:9

Notes:
- --video_resolution is required
- default model_version: seedance2.0_vip (unchanged)
- default duration: 5s
- omit --ratio to use 16:9
- local files are uploaded automatically before submit and use model-specific duration validation
- input counts, permissions, and runtime availability are ultimately determined by backend configuration
- duration, video_resolution, and any explicitly supplied ratio are strictly validated; unsupported or legacy values are rejected instead of silently adjusted
- 部分模型首次使用时，需要先在即梦 Web 端使用该模型完成首次生成。若提交生成任务后返回 AigcComplianceConfirmationRequired提示，则属于该情况。 For some models, first-time use requires completing an initial generation with the model on Dreamina Web. If the AigcComplianceConfirmationRequired message is returned after submitting a generation task, this requirement applies.


Flags:
      --image stringArray         repeat for each local input image path
      --video stringArray         repeat for each local input video path
      --audio stringArray         repeat for each local input audio path
      --prompt string             optional multimodal edit prompt
      --duration int              video duration in seconds; supported ranges by model: seedance2.5 -> 4-30; all other models -> 4-15 (default 5)
      --ratio string              supported values: 1:1, 3:4, 16:9, 4:3, 9:16, 21:9
      --video_resolution string   required; supported values by model: seedance2.5 -> 480p, 720p, or 1080p; seedance2.0_vip -> 720p, 1080p, or 4k; all other models -> 720p
      --model_version string      supported values: seedance2.0, seedance2.0fast, seedance2.0_vip, seedance2.0fast_vip, seedance2.0mini, seedance2.5
      --session int               session id (default 0 "默认对话") 
      --poll int                  submit then poll query_result for up to N seconds at 1s intervals (0 disables polling)
  -h, --help                      help for multimodal2video

Global Flags:
      --version   print build version information

Examples:
  dreamina multimodal2video --image ./input.png --prompt="turn this into a cinematic shot" --video_resolution=720p
  dreamina multimodal2video --image ./input.png --audio ./music.mp3 --model_version=seedance2.0fast --duration=5 --video_resolution=720p
  dreamina multimodal2video --image ./input.png --video ./ref.mp4 --audio ./music.mp3 --model_version=seedance2.0fast --duration=5 --video_resolution=720p

commands.session:
Usage:
  dreamina session [flags]

Manage Dreamina sessions (create, list, search, rename, delete).

A session is a container for organizing your creation history.
All generator commands accept a --session=<id> flag to submit tasks into a specific session.

Available Commands:
  create    Create a new session (auto-named or custom)
  list      List your recent sessions (alias: ls)
  search    Find a session ID by its name (alias: find)
  rename    Change a session's name (alias: update)
  delete    Delete a session (alias: rm)

Notes:
- All session commands require login (run "dreamina login" first).
- Session 0 is the default session. It cannot be renamed or deleted.
- Deleting a session will safely move its history back to the default session.


Flags:
  -h, --help   help for session

Global Flags:
      --version   print build version information

Examples:
  # 1. Create a session
  dreamina session create
  dreamina session create "My Video Project"

  # 2. List sessions (default 30; user-specified -n is capped at 100)
  dreamina session list
  dreamina session ls -n 100

  # 3. Find a session by name
  dreamina session search "Video"

  # 4. Rename a session
  dreamina session rename 10086 "New Project Name"

  # 5. Delete a session
  dreamina session rm 10086
